notes: The CLI reads its prompt on stdin under --print and emits JSON Lines under --output-format stream-json, which it refuses without --verbose. It runs with --bare, so it reads no user configuration, hooks, plugins or keychain and takes Anthropic authentication strictly from the declared credential identity; a person's interactive sign-in on the host therefore does NOT authenticate a mission, and readiness reports that distinction rather than hiding it. The program is located from the candidate list above, never through PATH, and it is a user-space runtime install, which is why executable trust is user-runtime. egress_allowlist names the one destination a real run was observed to contact once the CLI's non-essential traffic was switched off through --settings; with that switch off a second, non-Anthropic destination was observed on every run. The sandbox payload is uid 0 in an unshared user namespace and the CLI refuses its permission-bypass mode under root, so the same --settings block states IS_SANDBOX; without it the agent exits before writing one stream record. The credential VALUE is injected at the Firebreak boundary and never travels in the Invocation -- but it does reach the sandbox as an environment value, because no credential broker exists yet, so an agent that runs a shell inside the sandbox can read it.
